title: Appeals!

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello _AssassinPika_,

Since you have been banned for quite a long amount of time, I have decided to accept your appeal. However, if you are validly banned again, you will not have the chance to appeal your infraction. Be sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server.
 
Regards,
Qinn | Senior Moderator
